name: rdc
description: Remote Desktop Commander by TOC Ministries: a free, MIT-licensed local worker for compatible MCP clients, with files, durable jobs, independent browsers, headless automation, embedded previews, and optional device adapters.

interface.longDescription: Remote Desktop Commander (RDC) is an independent TOC Ministries project: a free, MIT-licensed local worker for self-hosted use with compatible MCP clients. Manage files and durable jobs, use independent browsers, and request saved-password fills with owner consent. The embedded live preview requires MCP Apps support; display modes depend on the host. Optional Android ADB and Appium adapters support configured Android, iPhone, and iPad workflows. Appium requires owner device setup, UiAutomator2 or XCUITest, and a compatible driver host. Native input uses the selected device's screen. This portable package requires an installed RDC command and configured worker; owner grants and OS permissions apply.
defaultPrompt: Check the connected RDC worker and its available capabilities.
